supporting_pages.title: Security overview \_|\_ GKE on AWS \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: AWS KMS encryption GKE on AWS uses customer-managed AWS Key Management Service (KMS) symmetric keys to encrypt: Kubernetes state data in etcd EC2 instance user data EBS volumes for at-rest encryption of control plane and node pool data For production environments, we recommend using different keys for configuration and volume encryption.
Key Rotation In contrast to certificate rotation, key rotation is the act of changing the underlying cryptographic material contained in a key encryption key (KEK) .
In addition, all GKE clusters enable Application-layer Secrets Encryption for sensitive data, such as Kubernetes Secret objects, which are stored in etcd .
